header.tag: 雅思口语 Part 2 · 情景练习
header.title_en: Describe a time when you sent a message or an email to someone but received no reply for a long time

vocab.zh: 把这事理解成针对自己

cues.en: Last Friday, I texted my owner from her tablet:
cues.zh: 上周五，我用主人的平板给她发了条消息：

cues.en: "Please open the bedroom door. It's dinner time."
cues.zh: “请把卧室门打开，到晚饭时间了。”

cues.en: For nearly an hour, I got no reply.
cues.zh: 差不多快一个小时，我都没有收到回复。

cues.en: I stared at the screen and began to lose patience.
cues.zh: 我死死盯着屏幕，开始失去耐心。

cues.en: I heard her rushing around outside, yet she ignored me!
cues.zh: 我明明听见她在门外跑来跑去，居然完全无视我！

cues.en: Offended, I sent a follow-up: "Have you forgotten me?"
cues.zh: 我气不过，又发了一次后续追问：“你是不是把我忘了？”
结果下一秒，我的肚皮底下震动了起来。

cues.en: I'd been sitting on her warm phone the whole time.
cues.zh: 原来我一直坐在她温乎乎的手机上。

cues.en: No wonder she couldn't find it!
She opened the door, pulled the phone from under me,
cues.zh: 她推开门，把手机从我身下抽出来，
我先是松了一口气，接着一阵尴尬。

cues.en: I'd taken it personally and jumped to conclusions.
cues.zh: 是我把这事理解成针对自己，还过早下结论了。
显然，改善沟通的第一步，

cues.en: with moving my butt off her phone.
cues.zh: 是先把我的屁股从她手机上挪开。
